spearheads.name: Bleak Host
spearheads.text:
The Plague God’s Bleak Hosts travel the length and breadth of the realms, ensuring his servants are spreading his virulent blessings. Under the strict command of their daemonic leader, known as a Spoilpox Scrivener, they shamble into battle to overwhelm their foes, couched in clouds of flies and the stench of decay. The tang of despair drives the swing of their weapons and widens their rictus grins ever further.
Though the Spoilpox Scrivener is a harsh taskmaster, the tactics they employ are wickedly effective. Pusgoyle Blightlords are sent ahead to break enemy lines, scything through formations of foot soldiers as their Rot Flies drive diseased stingers and fangs into any that dare approach. By the time these bloated behemoths are forced back, it is too late to stymie the shuffling waves of Plaguebearers. Each daemon is nightmare vision of what awaits the victims of Nurgle’s Rot, surrounded by swarms of insects and brandishing a sword ridden with supernaturally virulent diseases. Alongside them march the Blightkings, mortals swollen with the Grandfather’s blessings. Each can withstand tremendous punishment to their corpulent forms whilst swinging weapons with enough strength to crush their foes utterly. The Spoilpox Scrivener hangs back to direct the heaving masses, but woe betide those who draw near, for they are struck down by the tallymaster’s distended maw.

battle_traits.name: DAEMONIC SUMMONING
battle_traits.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: DISEASED
battle_traits.effect: Each time an attack made by a friendly model scores a critical hit, you receive 1 disease point, to a maximum of 7.

battle_traits.name: NURGLE'S EMBRACE
battle_traits.effect: Spend any number of your disease points. For each disease point you spend, pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any of your units and roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit (you can pick the same unit more than once).

regiment_abilities.name: INFESTED WITH WONDERS
regiment_abilities.effect: Each time a friendly model is slain, before it is removed from play, you can pick an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

enhancements.name: SUMMONER OF PLAGUEBEARERS
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 14" of your general.
enhancements.effect: Return 1 slain model to that unit.

enhancements.name: PESTILENT BREATH
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 7" of your general and roll a dice for each model in that unit.
enhancements.effect: For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

enhancements.name: GARDENER OF NURGLE
enhancements.declare: If your general is contesting an objective not contested by any enemy models, roll a dice.
enhancements.effect: On a 3+, that objective is considered by you to be desecrated. Friendly units have WARD (4+) while they are contesting a desecrated objective. If your opponent gains control of a desecrated objective, it is no longer desecrated.

enhancements.name: GIFT OF FEBRILE FRENZY
enhancements.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 7" of your general.

abilities.name: KEEP COUNTING, I'M WATCHING YOU
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 14" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

options.name: Tally of Blows
options.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s melee weapons.

options.name: Recorded Stamina
options.text: Add 1 to save rolls for the target unit.

abilities.name: CLOUD OF FLIES
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS ATTACKERS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy INFANTRY unit in combat with this unit to be the target and roll a dice for each model in this unit that is within the target unit’s combat range.
abilities.effect: For each roll that exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: WRACK AND RUIN
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

spearheads.name: Bubonic Cell
spearheads.text:
In exchange for his bountiful gifts, Papa Nurgle asks very little of his followers. He wishes only that they venture out into the realms and propagate his virulent Garden. All Maggotkin readily take up this task, but few do so with as much gusto and abandon as the Bubonic Cells.
Led by a Rotbringer Sorcerer, a Bubonic Cell will travel far and wide to bring contagion and decay to lands untouched by disease. Particularly ebullient and mischievous daemons are included in this foul assemblage, wrenched from the depths of the Grandfather’s domain through defiling rituals. These unnatural creatures are bound to the sorcerer who summons them and will gleefully infest any territory, no matter how remote. Mortal cultists are often drawn to these diseased hordes, warriors of the Rotmire Creed hoping to glean some pestilential knowledge to enhance the potency of their poisons. Inhospitable swamps are especially favoured; the daemons do so relish splashing around and spreading their innate filth, whilst the cultists see these mires as places soon to become their natural habitat.

battle_traits.name: NUMBERLESS PESTS
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units.

battle_traits.name: NAUSEOUS REVULSION
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

battle_traits.name: PLAGUE OF MISERY
battle_traits.effect: While enemy units are within 6" of any friendly units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.

battle_traits.name: BURGEONING FILTH
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly units.

regiment_abilities.name: CORRUPTION OF THE LAND
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature, then roll a dice for each enemy unit within 3" of that terrain feature.
regiment_abilities.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regiment_abilities.name: PUTREFIED GROUND
regiment_abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
Subtract 1 from the Move characteristic of enemy units. Subtract 1 from run rolls for enemy units.

enhancements.name: GASEOUS EMANATION
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit within your general’s combat range to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: SUBCUTANEOUS SUPPURATION
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: OVERRIPE DEATH'S HEADS
enhancements.declare: If your general is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 7" of them to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: FLESHY ABUNDANCE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: On a 6+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn

abilities.name: ATTENTION SEEKERS
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BILEWOOD STILTS
abilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit when it uses RETREAT abilities.
